entities.summary: William R. W. Murphy is an American professional baseball left-handed pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Arizona Diamondbacks and Toronto Blue Jays, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Chiba Lotte Marines being one of the most highly known pitchers in Japan during the 2010 season.
